question: What are Cloudflare Workers static-assets and Pages limits on the free plan: max file size, max files per deployment, and daily request limits?
statement: Cloudflare Free: 20,000 files per deploy, 25 MiB per file, Workers capped at 100,000 requests/day.
argument:
Max file size: 25 MiB per individual asset, for both Pages and Workers static assets (same on paid plans).

Files per deployment: 20,000 on the Free plan for both Pages sites and Workers static assets (per Worker version); paid plans allow 100,000.

Daily requests: Workers Free accounts get 100,000 requests/day, resetting at midnight UTC, after which Cloudflare returns Error 1027. The Workers limits page also notes route mode fail-open/fail-closed behavior when exceeded.

Caveats: Did not verify whether requests for static assets count toward the 100,000/day Worker request cap or are free/unlimited. Pages Functions request quota not separately checked.

claims.text: Workers static assets on Free allow 20,000 files per Worker version (100,000 on paid).
Pages sites on the Free plan can contain up to 20,000 files.
Maximum single file size is 25 MiB for both Pages assets and Workers static assets.
Workers Free accounts have a daily limit of 100,000 requests, resetting at midnight UTC.

subject: hosting

evidence.excerpt: Accounts on the Workers Free plan have a daily request limit of 100,000 requests, resetting at midnight UTC.
Cloudflare Pages sites can contain up to 20,000 files on the Free plan.
The maximum file size for a single Cloudflare Pages site asset is 25 MiB.
